top_signals.title: Musalem Signals Fed Rates Should Rise Over Next Six-to-Nine Months
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem signals interest rates should increase over the next six-to-nine months to help inflation return to the central bank’s 2% target. He speaks during an interview with Bloomberg's Michael McKee at the Future of Fixed Income conference in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
